about: Cromwell, Nova Zelandija (id cromwell): the circuit on the river terrace south of Cromwell in Central Otago, opened 2013, its long layout (4.100 km, 22 corners), one lap (docs/dirkalisca-celine.md, »Novih pet«): a figure of eight, the west part's lap crossing the east part's on the bridge w677363476 (bridge=yes, layer=1). The route: OSM's highway=raceway ways w234778728, w234778729, w234778731, w234778732 (the chicane before the south loop, not w234778731's straight there) and w677363474 (the bends north of the south-west hairpin, not w234778728's straight there), w677363475-477 (the straight over the bridge), closed, in the driving order; not the short cuts w234778733 (the east loop's), w234778731's nodes 74-75 (the club lap's, past the bridge), w234778729's nodes 0-7 and 34-37, w234778728's nodes 0-6, nor the links w537523924 and w537523943 to the paddock. The direction: as the bridge's ways w677363475-477, w677363474 and w234778729 are drawn in OSM (no source on the direction is reachable from here; OSM has no start line, pit lane nor pit building): south down the east straight, the east part clockwise, the west part anticlockwise. The pit lane and the pit building on the east side of the east straight, the start line by them (tools/cromwell/build.py).
